nodes.name: Webhook Verify (GET)
nodes.notes: This handles Meta's webhook verification challenge. Meta sends a GET request with hub.challenge that must be echoed back.

nodes.name: Webhook Events (POST)
nodes.notes: Receives comment and messaging events from Instagram via Meta Webhooks.

nodes.name: Contains Keyword?
nodes.notes: Edit the keyword here. Default triggers on 'dm'. You can add more conditions like 'link', 'free', 'guide', etc.

nodes.name: Send Instagram DM
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Customize the message template above with your actual links and PDFs. The commenter's name is automatically inserted.

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: Sent you a DM! 📩 Check your inbox.

nodes.name: Reply to Comment
nodes.notes: Optional: Replies to the comment letting them know a DM was sent.
